title: The Siren Call of Silicon Leviathan (arXiv 2609.28591)
author: Alexander Gamburd

metaphors.title: Silicon Leviathan and its Siren call
metaphors.paraphrase: AI labs as a Hobbesian Leviathan; accepting a certificate without demonstration is the bargain where authority, not truth, makes the law.

metaphors.title: Clergy, laity, and Lean as Latin
metaphors.paraphrase: Truths held on authority again: the prover's owners are the clergy, and the language the laity cannot read is Lean.

metaphors.title: Certificate of an unvisited monument
metaphors.paraphrase: A 616,000-line Lean proof is a reliable document about a monument no one has visited.

metaphors.title: Enlightenment twilight
metaphors.paraphrase: The Enlightenment bound itself to the mast of mathematics; the ship entering turbulent waters threatens the whole project (Aufklärungsdämmerung).

metaphors.title: Subhuman superintelligence
metaphors.paraphrase: Less than human in humanitas, more than human in speed; its builders cast as alchemists.

metaphors.title: Commons and enclosure
metaphors.paraphrase: Open literature is a commons and frontier models its enclosure; guarding work leads to a “Middle Ages in reverse.”

metaphors.title: Bloodless sword
metaphors.paraphrase: Withholding acceptance is the community's only weapon, the one sword the Leviathans cannot forge for themselves.

metaphors.title: Weil's three monsters
metaphors.paraphrase: Money, mechanisation and algebra fused into one body.

metaphors.title: AlphaZero test, Stockfish
metaphors.paraphrase: Sarnak's AlphaZero test; the Navier–Stokes run was Stockfish, not AlphaZero.
